text:
deploybot: :warning: RELEASE rc9 for service-x blocked by security gate
Reason: SBOM provenance mismatch and high sev vuln in transitive `libalpha` v3.2.1 (CVE-2025-1234). Package signature not verifiable.

maria: saw this, thanks. can we get the exact artifact digest and SBOM payload?

deploybot: artifacts: service-x:rc9 sha256:abcd1234...
SBOM link: https://ci.internal/sbom/service-x/rc9.json
vuln detail: https://scanner.internal/alerts/9876 (high, uncommon exploitability)
signature check: FAILED (no matching sig in release-store)

raj: quick triage: is this a false positive from transitive dependency or a new regression in our build?
kevin: likely transitive. libalpha@3.2.1 recently pulled in by parser-util@2.1.0. scanner flagged exploit pattern. need to check source repo and package signature chain.

anne: what's the risk to canary users? can we do a limited canary in non-prod regions while we investigate?
maria: we have change window tomorrow 02:00 UTC. canary today would be out-of-window unless we get a temporary exception.

kevin: options:
- pin to known-good digest (service-x:rc8) and proceed with rc8 -> canary
- request security exception for rc9 with strict canary (10% traffic, region-us-east) and rollback trigger on error
- block and patch dependency then rebuild (longer)

legal: if signature can't be verified, we need escalation for compliance. temporary exceptions need documented approval (security + legal).

raj: practical plan: 1) try to repro vuln locally by pulling sbom and running scanner on rc9, 2) attempt to pull signed artifact from release-store by digest, 3) if signature missing, check CI publish logs for signing step `gpg --detach-sign` or cosign.

maria: i'll fetch the CI logs now. @deploybot can you stash the rc9 artifacts so no one accidentally promotes? (reaction :lock:)
deploybot: artifacts for rc9 marked quarantined by policy. tag: quarantine/1769997777

kevin: quick check results: scanner reproduces vuln on rc9 image in a local run. signature metadata absent in release-artifacts bucket. build logs show cosign upload step failed 2025-08-12T21:03:12Z with `403 Forbidden` from kms.

anne: sounds like signing infrastructure outage during publish. that explains missing signature but vuln remains. two distinct issues.

maria: recommend: do NOT promote rc9. propose a temporary canary of rc8 with monitoring ramp (5% -> 20%) while infra team fixes signing and we patch/assess libalpha. ask for change-window exception to run controlled canary today on non-critical traffic.

kevin: agree. additionally, prepare a mitigation rule to block traffic patterns that would trigger exploit if it exists. create WAF rule and circuit-breaker thresholds.

legal: approve temporary canary with conditions: require security runbook, retention of all logs, timebox to 6 hours, and explicit rollback plan.

raj: i'll open a changelist: `cherry-pick rc8 -> canary-release`, add rollback hook `deploybot rollback service-x canary --if errors>3m` and a monitor dashboard.

maria: who owns contacting infra for cosign/KMS outage?

kevin: tagging @sre-oncall (notified)
sre-oncall: looking into KMS 403s now. initial cause: ephemeral IAM token expiry due to deployment of token-rotator last night. rolling back rotator to previous version now. ETA 18m.

maria: perfect. once signing is healthy, we can rebuild rc9, run scanner, and only promote if sig+scan pass.

kevin: for now we need the approval slack thread to document exception. legal granted verbal OK here. please add formal approval to the release ticket.

maria: filing release ticket note: "temporary canary on rc8 in non-prod region while infra resolves KMS and security triages libalpha. legal and security signed off; timebox 6h; rollback triggers configured." link: https://tickets.internal/REL-3421

deploybot: action: created canary job service-x:rc8 -> region-us-west-canary (job id 5764). status: queued.

kevin: runbook checklist before canary go:
- confirm quarantine tag on rc9 (done)
- WAF rule staged (kevin)
- monitor+alerts configured (raj)
- legal approval attached to ticket (maria)

maria: all done except WAF rule. kevin?

kevin: WAF rule staged and dry-run enabled, promoting to active at canary start.

sre-oncall: KMS rotator rollback complete, cosign uploads now succeed. will re-run signing for rc9 on request.

maria: decision summary (for release notes): 
- rc9 blocked due to missing signature and high-sev transitive vuln.
- temporary canary to proceed using rc8 in non-prod to validate runtime while we fix signing and triage libalpha.
- timeboxed 6h, documented approvals (security+legal), automatic rollback triggers.

anne: thanks. once rc9 is rebuilt and re-signed, do a full scan and we can consider re-promote in next change window.

kevin: I'll follow up with dependency owner to get a mitigation/patch for libalpha.

maria: closing loop: canary started at 1769997800, monitoring green at 1769997900, keeping quarantine on rc9 until signed + scan pass.

deploybot: canary job 5764 started by maria at 1769997800. status: running.

maria: (thumbsup) thanks team. documenting minutes to ticket REL-3421.

legal: added approval note to REL-3421: "Limited canary approved 2025-08-13 by legal on condition of timebox and rollback plan."

kevin: marking this thread resolved. will re-open if any showstopper appears. :white_check_mark:
